title: Intuitive Surgical July 2026 Form 8-K on amended bylaws
excerpt: The board amended the bylaws on July 23, including shareholder-nomination disclosures, special-meeting mechanics and a majority-of-votes-cast standard for corporate actions other than elections.
summary: This post-Q2 governance filing does not supersede the Q2 financial inputs but corrects the prior description of all later filings as ownership reports.
